applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Non- Banking Financial Companies – Financial Statements: Presentation and Disclosures) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: No action is required by NBFCs as these directions introduce an exemption for government-owned and controlled Upper Layer NBFCs.
answer.action_quote: Provided that these provisions shall not be applicable to NBFC-UL which are fully owned and controlled by Government.

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into force with effect from date of issuance.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Non- Banking Financial Companies – Financial Statements: Presentation and Disclosures) Directions, 2025
